mappings.mapping_basis: Revisão do corpo stock via Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code e source; contrato de devres, sysfs, hrtimer e regulator conferido no kernel NX809J. Rebuild Docker reproduzível requerido; revisão independente e hardware pendentes.
mappings.mapping_note: O corpo stock foi preservado como nb_fan_probe_stock_exact, trocando regulator_get por devm_regulator_get; o wrapper nb_fan_probe desfaz timer inicializado, kobject, drvdata e o ponteiro global em qualquer retorno de erro. Divergência intencional do stock; não declarar OFFLINE_EXACT nesta revisão. Evidência detalhada em reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_lifecycle_hardening_20261102/lifecycle_hardening_review.json e build em reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_lifecycle_hardening_20261102/driver_audit.json.

mappings.mapping_basis: Revisão do corpo stock via Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code e source; contrato de devres, sysfs, hrtimer e regulator conferido no kernel NX809J. Rebuild Docker reproduzível requerido; revisão independente e hardware pendentes.
mappings.mapping_note: Remove o grupo sysfs e drena callbacks, cancela o hrtimer, tenta desligar o nível do fan, drena as referências de enable do regulador, limpa drvdata, libera o kobject e despublica chip. Divergência intencional do stock; não declarar OFFLINE_EXACT nesta revisão. Evidência detalhada em reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_lifecycle_hardening_20261102/lifecycle_hardening_review.json e build em reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_lifecycle_hardening_20261102/driver_audit.json. Supplemental target-kernel API review: regulator_disable errors can occur before or after the consumer count changes; the bounded drain stops on ambiguity. regulator_force_disable is not safe for shared consumers. Residual retained; no status promotion. Evidence: attestation/soc_fan_regulator_disable_contract_20261103/review.json.

mappings.target_config_note: The pinned NX809J .config has CONFIG_OF_DYNAMIC=undef; OF node refcount get/put are no-ops in this build. This does not generalize to CONFIG_OF_DYNAMIC=y.

mappings.mapping_note: Substitui gpio_request e request_threaded_irq por variantes devm; o driver core libera IRQ e GPIO antes da memória devm do chip. Divergência intencional do stock; não declarar OFFLINE_EXACT nesta revisão. Evidência detalhada em reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_lifecycle_hardening_20261102/lifecycle_hardening_review.json e build em reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_lifecycle_hardening_20261102/driver_audit.json.

A fase compartilhada com fan_speed_show usa READ_ONCE/WRITE_ONCE; o contador no offset +0x04, incrementado atomicamente pelo callback IRQ stock, usa atomic_read/atomic_set. Dois builds Docker limpos mantêm o corpo AArch64 de 70 instruções/280 bytes idêntico ao stock. Evidência: reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_timer_shared_state_atomicity_20261103/timer_state_access_review.json.

mappings.mapping_note: HARDENED_STOCK_DEVIATION: regulator enable references are routed through ownership-counting wrappers and drained during teardown. The current-level byte is published with WRITE_ONCE and read with READ_ONCE by the timer diagnostic; function-level assembly differs from stock intentionally due to regulator wrapper calls. See reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_lifecycle_hardening_20261102/lifecycle_hardening_review.json and reverse_engineering/validation/reconstructed/soc_fan/attestation/soc_fan_sysfs_serialization_hardening_20261102/sysfs_state_lock_review.json. Stock Ghidra confirms a regulator error can be masked by a later successful PWM apply; this stock behavior is retained and remains a declared hardening deviation. Evidence: attestation/soc_fan_regulator_disable_contract_20261103/review.json.
